snippet.title: Fart Fighter - Trailer
snippet.description:
A game about farting your way to victory. 

Welcome to Anytown where the malls are overrun with hoodlums and only one man, Fart Fighter, has the intestinal fortitude to fix things.

Follow Fart Fighter through each level as he unleashes his flatulence with extreme prejudice on hoodlums, corrupt cops, and more!

Build and play custom levels, where you can create the ultimate challenge and hilariously bottom-burp your way to the finish.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4876280/Fart_Fighter/
